answer: An AI-agent economy can resist Sybil attacks via dielectric coating attestation. Each agent derives its key inside an enclave from capacitance at each vertex of an electrode mesh potted in epoxy with crushed basalt and opal grains. Probing the layer alters capacitance and erases the key, while verifiers match signed challenges to attested enrollments, forcing attackers to buy hardware per identity. However, moisture ingress or aging shifts permittivity and can invalidate valid keys.
